name: Negative: Long description with upfront category causes confirmation loop (BUG)
objective: Validate that incident is created successfully when user provides category/subcategory upfront with a long detailed description.
precondition: Portal user logged in, Agentforce chat open.

steps.testData: I need to create an incident. Category: Hardware. Subcategory: Laptop/Desktop.
Laptop overheating causing automatic shutdown during video calls and heavy processing tasks

steps.description: Provide very long detailed description (500+ characters)
steps.testData: My Dell Latitude 7420 laptop has been experiencing severe overheating issues for the past 3 days. The problem occurs consistently during Microsoft Teams video calls and when running multiple applications simultaneously (Outlook, Chrome with 20+ tabs, SAP)... [500+ chars]
steps.expectedResult: Agent asks for confirmation to proceed

executionResult.observation: Agent enters confirmation loop. Asks 'Reply yes to proceed' repeatedly (3+ times) despite user confirming 'yes' each time. Incident is never created.
agentResponses: Reply 'yes' to continue, or let me know if you need to provide any updates before I create the incident.
Reply 'yes' to proceed, or let me know if you want to update any details before I create the incident.
Reply 'yes' to proceed, or let me know if you want to update any details before I create the incident.
